enable_isatap.description: Enable ISATAP client mode — required to create and maintain the tunnel.

isatap_router_ipv4.description: IPv4 address of the ISATAP router — must be globally routable and reachable.

tunnel_interface.description: Name of the virtual tunnel interface to create (e.g., isatap0).

ipv6_prefix.description: IPv6 prefix (in CIDR notation) assigned to ISATAP clients for address generation.

max_tunnels.description: Maximum number of concurrent ISATAP tunnels (per RFC 5214, limited by system resources).

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging (debug = most verbose, error = least).

routers.description: List of static IPv4 addresses or hostnames for known ISATAP routers (optional, fallback to discovery).

items.description: IPv4 address or hostname of a known ISATAP router.

enable_multicast.description: Enable IPv4 multicast (IGMP) to receive router advertisements via multicast.

router_solicit_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between periodic router solicitations. Set to 0 to disable.

router_ttl.description: Time-to-live for router solicitations (must be 1 per RFC 5214).

enable_stateful.description: Enable DHCPv6-based stateful address configuration if SLAAC fails.

enable_stateless.description: Enable stateless address autoconfiguration (SLAAC) for ISATAP clients.

dns_servers.description: List of IPv4 or IPv6 addresses of DNS servers for ISATAP clients.

items.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address of a DNS server.

route_metric.description: Route metric for ISATAP default route — lower values have higher priority.

mtu.description: Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) for the ISATAP tunnel interface.

keepalive_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between keepalive probes; 0 disables keepalive.

auth_key.description: Authentication key for ISATAP router discovery — must be in hex or base64 format if used.
